_comment: Provenance for the BURN loop set. Every delivered loop in loops/ is built
from one of these Higgsfield generations by tools/build_loops.sh.
All were generated with Seedance 2.0, 16:9, 720p, std mode, 10s requested
(the model returns 241 frames = 10.041667s at 24fps), using the SAME image
as both start_image and end_image so the model is obliged to return to its
origin. That is the core loop technique - see CONCEPT_BURN_10S_LOOP.md 5.1.
Delivered length is 9.541667s (229 frames), not 10.000s: the 0.5s overlap
blend is subtracted from the source and nothing is retimed to make it back
up. See the duration note in build_loops.sh.
